blocks.title: Procurement and Supply of Materials and Equipment for Oil and Gas Industries
blocks.intro: We provide an equipment and material procurement and supply service to the oil and gas industry throughout Africa and the rest of the world.

elements.html:
Our role is to find and supply all the manufactured goods associated with the exploration and delivery of oil and gas. Our customers expect an exceptional level of service and we fulfil that expectation by delivering a reliable, honest, diligent and conscientious service that meets their specific demands.

With many years experience in the oil industry Worldwide Procurement Services has relationships with renowned manufacturers, major mills and suppliers in the UK, across Europe, USA, Far East and the Sub-Continent and are able to supply equipment to the correct specification, on time and within budget.

Working for oil and gas companies primarily in Nigeria, Cameroon, Ghana, Kenya, Angola and other African nations we can procure and ship all equipment and material used in exploration, drilling, marine services, production and oil product disciplines.
